title: Lead Associate | ServiceNow | Across Locations | Engineering as a Service/ Operate
description:
**Service Now IRM:**

  
  

Required:

years of overall and relevant ServiceNow experience in implementing applications such as IRM (Integrated Risk Management), SIR, VR, TPRM, BCM.

Demonstrated experience with technical aspects of ServiceNow, including workflow design, APIs, web services, and integrations using connectors (preferred).

Hands-on experience configuring Workspace, UI Builder, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Scripts, UI Actions, UI Pages, Script Includes, Access Control Lists, complex workflows/Flow Designer, and migrating solutions to higher environments.

Well-versed in various ServiceNow products and platform capabilities.

Proficient in defining epics and user stories, creating UI mock-ups, and adopting a hands-on approach to drive results.

Ability to conduct regular code reviews, adopt ServiceNow best practices for software design and development across the platform ecosystem, and provide technical guidance to colleagues and customers to resolve questions and issues.

Experience designing, configuring, and developing product automations and integrations.

Skilled in the design and development of scoped applications of varying complexity.

Proficient in ServiceNow platform management such as deployments, upgrades and troubleshooting.

Collaborate with Functional Consultants and Business Analysts to create and estimate user stories, and propose solutions that meet or exceed customer expectations for quality and user experience.

Experience in developing and maintaining ServiceNow product knowledge and/or certifications.

Ability to prioritize personal and team workloads and consistently meet deadlines.

Excellent documentation, presentation, verbal, and written communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with teams across geographical locations.

Must have delivered more than 2–3 projects end-to-end, from requirement gathering through to go-live.

Mandatory: ServiceNow Certified System Administrator

  

Preferred:

Must have ServiceNow IRM or Security Operations module implementation experience (like Risk Management, Audit Management, Policy Management, Vendor Risk Management & SIR Modules, etc.)

Good to have ITAM, SAM, HAM & CMDB experience.

Good to have ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD).

Good to have CIS - Risk and Compliance Implementation specialist certification.

Good to have CIS – Security Incident Response Implementation specialist certification.

Good to have CIS – Third Party Risk Management Implementation specialist certification.

Good to have CIS – Vulnerability Response Implementation specialist certification.

Good to have knowledge of strategic roadmap development for GRC technologies ServiceNow and other like RSA Archer , MetricStream

title: Quality Analyst
description:
**Experience : 3 to 5 Years**

What you’ll do

● Review requirements, user stories, and designs; identify gaps, edge cases, and acceptance criteria.

● Plan and perform functional, regression, exploratory, integration, and user acceptance testing.

● Build and maintain automated tests for critical user journeys across web and mobile.

● Test APIs and backend workflows, including request validation, responses, error handling, and data consistency.

● Test Salesforce features and workflows, including record creation and updates,permissions, automation, reports, and integrations.

● Validate end-to-end scenarios such as registration, profile and credential updates, job search, applications, recruiter interactions, and status changes.

● Verify data flows between the product, Salesforce, and connected services; investigate sync failures and duplicate or missing records.

● Track test cases, defects, and QA work in Jira; write clear, reproducible bug reports and verify fixes.

● Collaborate with developers to reproduce issues and improve testability.

● Maintain test plans, test cases, automation suites, and release quality notes.

● Participate in release readiness reviews and help the team make risk-based testing decisions.

● Consider accessibility, usability, privacy, and security in day-to-day testing.

What you’ll bring

● 3+ years of experience in software QA, including both manual and automation testing.

● Experience testing web applications and REST APIs.

● Hands-on experience with an automation framework such as Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium.

● Experience with API testing tools such as Postman or equivalent.

● Salesforce testing experience, ideally with Sales Cloud or Service Cloud.

● Understanding of Salesforce objects, fields, relationships, profiles and permissions, Flows, reports, and integration behavior.

● Practical experience using Jira to manage defects, test work, and project workflows.

● Ability to write clear test scenarios and communicate defects with useful steps, expected results, and actual results.

● Familiarity with SQL or another method of validating application data.

● Understanding of the software development lifecycle, Agile practices, and CI/CD workflows.

● Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to prioritize testing based on user and business impact.

Good to have

● Experience testing mobile applications or responsive web experiences.

● Experience with healthcare, recruiting, staffing, or job marketplace products.

● Familiarity with AI-enabled features, including conversational search and recommendations.

● Experience with Salesforce integration testing, such as REST APIs, middleware, or event-driven data flows.

● Familiarity with accessibility and cross-browser testing.

Pay: From ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Leave encashment

Work Location: In person

* CA / MBA
* Good verbal, written communication & presentation skills.
